hero.title: Learn Artificial Intelligence in practice, from zero to advanced.
hero.body: INEMA Club is a hands-on learning ecosystem for people who want to master artificial intelligence and apply it at work, in projects and in their careers. The core idea is simple: learn, practice and evolve with AI continuously.
hero.body2: Here you will find practical, to-the-point courses, real projects to get your hands dirty, paths organized for every level, an active community and a curated set of the best tools. All of it aimed at building a solid knowledge base — one that makes you more productive, more strategic and better prepared for the future of work.

beginners.title: Beginner Path
beginners.subtitle: Start your journey with the essential courses, in this recommended order
beginners.body: This is not a random list: it is a progression. You start by learning to talk to AI (FEP), see those skills in action (ATIA), build the technical data foundation (FDB) and expand to images (Vision). Only then do you move to code-agent tools — Claude Code and Codex — which bring it all together in practice, before shipping a real project (Do Zero ao Deploy) and finishing by building your own AI system (INTELECTO). Skipping steps creates gaps: later courses assume the foundation of earlier ones.
beginners.footer: After completing this path, explore other courses by interest below

iaZero.title: 🌱 Never used AI? Start with IA do Zero
iaZero.subtitle: Before step 1 of the path: four short lessons, a kit of twenty ready-made prompts and, right after, FEP rewritten for 2026
iaZero.body: Nothing technical, nothing to install. You learn the three parts of a request, the four chat buttons, what to check before passing it on, and leave with your own kit of five prompts filled in and tested. When you finish, FEP 2026 shows what changed in how we ask now that AGI has arrived, and the path above makes sense.

cards.cursoDesc: 4 lessons of 16 to 20 min: ask well, use the chat, check, build your kit
cards.kitDesc: 20 ready-made prompts by situation, with what you should see and the common mistake
cards.fepDesc: AGI arrived and the prompt almost died: FEP rewritten technique by technique (7 lessons)

iaCultivada.title: 🌱 Cultivated AI: everything you can do with this subject
iaCultivada.subtitle: AI is not programmed, it is grown. The eight elements (role, context, tools, rules, examples, memory, evaluation, feedback) applied to personal life, your Jarvis and business
iaCultivada.body: The page explains the method with the 2025–2026 research behind it. The ready-made solutions put it to work today: downloadable kits, an agent role-card generator, a two-minute diagnostic, skills for Claude Code and Codex, and agent packs by area. All static, no sign-up.

cards.paginaDesc: Concept, the two levels of cultivation, the eight elements, the cycle and the three applications with 30- and 90-day plans
cards.kitsDesc: Personal, Jarvis and company: the five files already structured, with a fictional example filled in
cards.geradorDesc: Fill six fields and download the role card, context, examples, scorecard and failure log
cards.diagDesc: Eight questions: your score, the garden stage, where to start and the right kit
cards.skillsDesc: For Claude Code and Codex: the agent writes the files and runs the feedback ritual every Friday
cards.pacotesDesc: Complete lead qualifier with system prompt and n8n flow, plus support, finance and marketing
